warnings.text:
Effect.provide wraps a program in a call; write it as a block: provide Layer { … }.
  No quick fix: a provide block stands only as a statement or a return; run the call in one, such as a function that returns it.
unstableApiUsage: `effect/http/HttpClient#HttpClient` is an unstable API. Breaking changes may happen between versions. effect(unstableApiUsage)
unstableApiUsage: `effect/http/HttpClient#HttpClient` is an unstable API. Breaking changes may happen between versions. effect(unstableApiUsage)

HostModelUnusable extends Schema.TaggedError; a schema error declaration, schema error HostModelUnusable { … }, writes the same failure with its Schema.
  No quick fix: a schema error's tag is its name.

HostModel extends Context.Service; in VibeLang a service is a service declaration: service HostModel { … }.
  No quick fix: move its static members into the declaration. Keep its key in the declaration: static readonly key = "@smthrs/model-host/HostModel".

schemaClassObjectLiteral: This object literal is checked as an instance of Schema class 'GenerationParams' but has no class prototype. instanceof checks, methods, and Schema encoding can fail. Use 'GenerationParams.make(...)' or 'new GenerationParams(...)' instead. effect(schemaClassObjectLiteral)
